t: This is Leadenhall Street, in the City of London. It runs about a third of a mile, linking Cornhill in the west to Aldgate in the east. It was once the start of the A11 road from London to Norwich, but that road now begins further east, at Aldgate. The merchant Micaiah Perry died on this street in 1721. He was born around 1641, and he is one of the City people tied to this street's history.
